verdict.rationale: The evidence describes retention policies, org-wide recording/access policies, and Super Admin data export/delete capabilities, but nowhere states whether meeting data is used to train AI models nor provides an explicit opt-out for model training, nor cites SOC 2 or HIPAA certification. Missing for 10: explicit AI-training data usage/opt-out statement, SOC 2 report/attestation, HIPAA compliance documentation.
